summary: Perma-Fix Environmental Services filed a Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, furnishing an updated investor presentation, 'Investor Presentation, September 2026,' as Exhibit 99.1, also posted to its website; the report was signed by CFO Ben Naccarato. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is disclosed; the filing is a routine Regulation FD-style investor communication, not a special situation. What to watch: any subsequent 8-K disclosing a strategic transaction, financing, or guidance change that would elevate the name beyond a routine disclosure.
